theme: Advanced Light Theme with High-Contrast Deep Obsidian accents.

typography.rules: H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl. Subheadings jump max 2 steps. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro / Swiss High-Contrast Hybrid
colors.primary_accent: Electric Coral (#FF4500) / orange-600 - Use as the kinetic trigger for main actions.
colors.admin_sidebar: Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) background with stark white text for a 'command center' feel.
colors.rules: Color is function. Never use full-screen gradients. Do not use generic SaaS Blue. Tint neutral greys slightly with blue (cool) or orange (warm).

visual_enhancers.public_portal: Use 'Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant)' for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200. Layered ambient shadows for floating cards.
visual_enhancers.admin_dashboard: Use 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)'. 1px subtle borders (border-collapse). No glassmorphism. Flat solid surfaces.
visual_enhancers.borders: Nested radii: child <= parent; concentric. Max 8px border-radius (rounded-md/rounded-lg) for a sharp, competitive athletic feel.

components.public_hero: Raw HTML/Tailwind. Overlapping asymmetrical images. Heavy typography overlay. Max overlay opacity: bg-black/40.
components.admin_table: Shadcn dense data table. Compact padding (py-2). Left-align text, right-align numbers. Fixed headers for scrolling.
components.knowledge_base_card: Cardless or subtle 1px border. Dense meta-data (Category, Status) on left. Use strong typographic hierarchy for 'Decision' and 'Reasoning/WHY'.
components.forms_and_modals: Use Shadcn customized components. Strip Vercal-look, apply stark borders and Electric Coral focus rings.

grids.public_portal: Mode A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetrical, wide gap-8 to gap-12. Leave breathing room.
grids.admin_dashboard: Mode B (High Density Grid). Tight gap-4. Every pixel utilized. col-span logic for data heavy cards.

layouts.public: Mobile-first, wide generous padding (py-20, px-6 md:px-12). Clear navigation hierarchy.
layouts.admin: Sidebar left-nav layout (Obsidian background). Dense top nav for global search. Scrollable main content area.

motion.public: Smooth scrolling (lenis recommended if possible). Subtle hover transforms (-translate-y-1) on schedule cards.
motion.admin: Minimalist. Instant feedback. Row hover states in tables. Do not overuse animations.
motion.rules: MUST use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-transform, transition-opacity). NO 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

media.image_rules: Max 80vh on mobile. Never use placeholder text for logos/images. Ensure hero images have sufficient breathing room.

3d_libraries.decision: BANNED for this specific project. The user explicitly requested 'Do not overuse animations. Do not build a flashy landing page at the expense of usability'. Focus purely on world-class 2D typography, dense grids, and high-performance tables.

hero_background.description: Modern brick architecture with multiple levels. Use for the Main Home Hero section of the Public Portal.

venues_food.description: Modern dining area. Use for Food or Venues section headers.

competition_crowd.description: People watching soccer game. Use for Teams or Schedule section visuals.

instructions_to_main_agent: The project uses React with .js/.jsx files (not TypeScript). Adjust your Shadcn component installations and code generation to JavaScript.
Build a dual-surface app: The Public Portal must be welcoming, spacious, and typographic. The Admin side must be dense, strict, and highly operational.
Public Portal spacing: Use Generous Spacing (py-16, py-24). Admin Dashboard spacing: Use Dense Spacing (py-4, gap-4).
Implement the 'Cluster Knowledge Base' with precision. Decisions and reasoning must be crystal clear. Use badges for status/categories.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Inject the 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts via CSS and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
All navigation must be visible on desktop. Do not hide primary links in a hamburger menu on desktop.
Header must have a solid or frosted glass background, NEVER fully transparent if content scrolls beneath.
Use Phosphor Icons or lucide-react for sharp, modern iconography.
Unfinished sections must be clearly marked as 'Coming Later' with a structured empty state.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable on the public portal. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
